notes.233: Lines 234-235 are loosely built; taken as 'this would not seem enough to Lucifer'. gesmahte (265) is taken as 'tasted'.
notes.979: 'salten vüre' (1044) is obscure; taken as 'handed over beforehand'. Who 'him' is at 989 and 1012-1014, and in 1031, is uncertain.

nodes.text: so that they should praise him;
he wanted to set his throne
For that he paid with his honour,
since he did not let it suffice him
that he was as like God
as the wax is to the seal,
which is pressed against it for this purpose:
that it may bear an image like it.
That might well have sufficed him.
He seemed to himself so fair
that in his will he then said
he would be equal to the Most High.
that he could well turn him back from it;
yet he did it with this intent:
however it might go for him,
or however he might begin it,
he would still forever be against God.
He says that he did not wait so long
as soon as he was fully created,
him and all who in the sin
would join with him and stand by him;
they had to fall from there
where they have anguish and distress
That will be made plain to us here.
for which they had been created,
then the tenth choir would stand empty
the goodness of God as well,
which afterwards drove him from heaven;
so his wisdom reminded him of this:
what would happen to the angels,
His goodness bade him not leave empty
the choir because of their misdeed;
his wisdom gave him the counsel,
which is to govern all things,
that if he wished the angels' fall
he should create himself a son,
and went over to the devil,
that this would come off so lightly
whenever he kept all his children
so that he then led them
that he might do it so easily;
he would ask nothing of him
he would have, for the highest choir,
which was given to the lowest,
if he had wished to create
such that it could never fall.
He would well have made good his loss to him,
that we should have come so high
is given to us as a homeland,
that we should live there forever
and nothing was handed to them there beforehand
unless they would do God's will?
For that reason he gave us freedom:
who of their own will chose to stand by him.
Now he has provided for it all,
so that you, with their help, go
that Saint Peter went in there
did not seem unjust to Saint Michael,
for the toils of the two were unequal.
had thus provided for his praise
